strings.demo.arsenal: 6 weapons at max level, 2500 soaked foes
strings.garage.head: Head
strings.garage.title: TSUKUMO
strings.hint.garage: Arrows to browse the parts, {back} to go back
strings.main.controls: Move: stick / WASD    Fire: button 1 / J    Aim lock: button 2 / K    Dash: button 3 / Space    Pause: Start / Esc
strings.passive.lifesteal.description: Each kill restores 1% of max health. One time only.
strings.passive.reach.description: +12% area for novas, rain, flasks, blades, slams, mines.
strings.tsukumo.blizzard.1: Snow! Can I build a snow-Tsukumo?
strings.tsukumo.evolution.1: My cannon changed! Do I look cool?
strings.tsukumo.heal.1: Mmm, almost as good as cold-pressed oil!
strings.tsukumo.heatwave.2: So hot! Is this a summer holiday?
strings.tsukumo.horde_cleared.1: Horde gone! Do I win a prize?
strings.tsukumo.horde_cleared.2: Quiet again. Too quiet. Hee hee!
strings.tsukumo.horde_incoming.1: Oh. That's a lot of new friends.
strings.tsukumo.horde_incoming.2: Unit 7 never trained me for this!
strings.tsukumo.idle.1: Hey, how much does a soul weigh?
strings.tsukumo.idle.2: Does the Chief like me best? Be honest!
strings.tsukumo.idle.3: Why do humans sleep? Such wasted uptime!
strings.tsukumo.idle.4: I counted my legs. Still four. Phew!
strings.tsukumo.idle.5: Am I unique, or just well synced?
strings.tsukumo.level_up.1: I feel smarter. Is this a soul?
strings.tsukumo.level_up.2: Level up! Umano-san would be proud!
strings.tsukumo.level_up.3: New parts! Can I keep them?
strings.tsukumo.low_health.1: Is this what humans call fear?
strings.tsukumo.low_health.2: My armour hurts. Can armour hurt?
strings.tsukumo.low_health.3: If I break, will I still be me?
strings.tsukumo.rival_left_behind.1: No fair! You got all the cold-pressed oil!
strings.tsukumo.rival_left_behind.2: Wait for me! We sync tonight anyway!
strings.tsukumo.rival_overtaken.1: Ha! I'm higher level than you now!
strings.tsukumo.rival_overtaken.2: Who's the slow Tsukumo now? Not me!
strings.tsukumo.rival_stole_kill.1: That one was mine! I had it locked!
strings.tsukumo.rival_too_close.2: Personal space! I read about it!
strings.tsukumo.run_start.3: Let's go, let's go, let's go!
strings.tsukumo.spider_inbound.1: It has more legs than me. Unfair!
strings.tsukumo.spider_inbound.2: A big cousin! He looks grumpy.
strings.tsukumo.spider_inbound.3: Can tanks be friends? No? Okay.
strings.tsukumo.storm.1: If I rust, do I get older?
strings.tsukumo.worm_blast.2: Hey! That's no way to say hello!
strings.tsukumo.worm_down.2: Was that a worm or a train?
strings.tsukumo.worm_frost.1: Its mouth is glowing blue... dodge!
strings.tsukumo.worm_head.1: Its head came off... and it's still coming!
strings.tsukumo.worm_head.2: Just a head left? It's rolling at me!
strings.tsukumo.worm_inbound.1: The ground is purring. That's not normal!
strings.tsukumo.worm_inbound.2: Something big is drilling under the ground!
strings.weapon.arc_lightning.description: Strikes the enemy you aim at, then chains.
strings.weapon.ember_bolt.description: Fires burning bolts where you aim.
strings.weapon.frost_shard.description: Fires ice shards where you aim.
strings.weapon.pulse_shot.description: Fires plain energy bolts where you aim.
strings.weapon.volt_bolt.description: Fires charged bolts where you aim.
